feedback.delta: Insert an explicit cognition-snapshot -> effect-intent -> fresh relevant-dependency/capability revalidation -> opaque runtime authority sequence into the current H1 semantic spine.

snapshot_commit.py plus regression tests; future Golden Traces must include unrelated-change success, relevant-change abort, capability-epoch abort, dependency-laundering reassembly and crash/replay identity.

Do not hold/upgrade a cognition-phase stale read snapshot as the effect write transaction. Materialize snapshot identity, then perform a fresh commit transaction with versioned relevant-dependency revalidation. Benchmark dependency-closure maintenance versus whole-epoch invalidation on Ubuntu.

H2 must be able to represent CognitiveSnapshot, explicit relevant dependency versions, EffectIntent and CommitGuardDecision(authority NONE) plus fresh capability epoch revalidation. This is a typed library/runtime requirement first, not evidence for new core syntax.

Any effect-producing workspace episode must preserve which snapshot/dependency closure informed the proposal. Recurrence policy experiments must keep controller-independent trajectory/post-hoc-readout baselines because halt readout quality can alter conclusions.
Causal tests involving timing-sensitive commit/re-entry must bind observation configuration to execution identity when probe overhead is non-negligible relative to decision slack.
Unresolved alternatives remain cognitive/proposal state. If an effect selects one alternative, its effect-relevant dependency identities must be included in the commit revalidation closure.
Derived topology/activation may select relevant dependencies but does not make them true or authoritative. Repeated ancestry remains correlated evidence; no RAB promotion is made.

Whole-system architecture now has a concrete executable interface between bounded cognition and opaque effect authority, reducing a major H1 semantic ambiguity without selecting research-only GWT/recurrence/topology mechanisms.
